_comment: The diplomacy audience (wire ids 57 player, 58 AI; open fixes 46 and 47), work order 185 part 10. Geometry is screens/audience/augeom.py (transcribed from dip_scrn_main.cpp and fields.cpp); every word on the screen is the engine's, carried by open fix 47's DIPL block; the stage is DIPLOMAT.LBX's own art. The marks name every difference, each held by the audience smoke group and named in dev:v3_projektstatus.md.

marks.deviation_hud_frameless: HUD panels behind the statement and the menu, where the original prints on the room.
marks.omission_talking_loop: The ambassador's animation is not drawn: its phase is not on the wire. The still is the frame the original shows with animations off.
marks.omission_header_line: JIMTEXT2's header line at (320, 10) — 'Player n: name' or 'race Ambassador' — needs an extraction this order does not add.
marks.transcription_audience_help: TRANSCRIPTION — a right click opens the help the original's active list names at that native point (Setup_Diplomacy_Help_ / Setup_Full_Screen_Diplomacy_Help_, dip_scrn_main.cpp:1966-2043), the list read off open fix 69's HLPL block (core/helplist.py). Work order 200; it replaces 185's omission.
marks.omission_glass_remap: The ambassador's glassed pixels are drawn as their palette indices, a hatching; the original remaps them against what lies beneath (Update_Glass_Remap_Colors_, dip_scrn_main.cpp:476). The engine's own framebuffer shows the same hatching (part 11, side by side), so the remap's effect, if any, lies beyond what the wire shows — not measured.
marks.omission_fade_in: The room's fade-in (up to 38 frames of the room's entry before the ambassador appears, dip_scrn_main.cpp:1985-2016) is not played: HD shows the ambassador and the statement at once, where the original still fades (seen side by side, part 11).
marks.transcription_system_picker: TRANSCRIPTION — the diplomacy system picker (id 85, open fix 109's TPOP kind 25; Diplomacy_System_Display, dip_scrn.cpp:701-805): a click sends a star's own hidden field, resolved in the list just read, only for a system the original takes (the giver's, May_Surrender_Star, no capitol), or CANCEL's; the hover's lines as Draw_Diplomacy_System_Text prints them (dip_scrn.cpp:2329-2374). Work order 322 E, screens/audience/aupicker.py.
marks.deviation_picker_hud_box: The picker's galaxy box is a HUD panel and its stars the inset maps' dots in the owners' colours, where the original draws DIPSTARS.LBX's background and FLEET.LBX's star sprites (view mode 4, movebox.cpp:89-91); neither is extracted.
marks.deviation_picker_special_colour: A system the original will not take is printed in its special colours (palette index 250 against 253, dip_scrn.cpp:63-65, not measured); HD uses its sub text role.
marks.unverified_system_picker_live: The picker is drawn from stand-in bytes only, not from the engine (Data's decision of 20 October 2026: no live runs).
